title: Network Infrastructure Engineer
content_text: City of Greater Geelong PageUp job 500747, read 15 Oct 2026 AEDT. Two positions, Permanent Full Time (part time considered), Band 6 $98,633.63 pa plus super. Manage the City's civil infrastructure network (roads, footpaths, bridges, associated civil assets); coordinate and assess third-party road reserve works and heavy-vehicle access applications; engineering investigations and recommendations; support planning and delivery of capital works; train and support others in the team. About you: experience in civil engineering; tertiary or technical qualifications in civil engineering or construction highly desirable. Essential Experience: experience undertaking infrastructure investigations, assessing engineering issues and providing technical advice relating to roads, footpaths, bridges or associated civil infrastructure assets; stakeholder management; written and verbal communication; planning and prioritisation; apply civil engineering principles, legislation, standards and policies to roads, road-reserve access and civil infrastructure with an appreciation of drainage interfaces; current Victorian Drivers Licence; National Police Check. Enquiries: Aaron McGlade, Coordinator Civil Infrastructure Planning, AMcGlade@geelongcity.vic.gov.au. Applications close 28 Oct 2026 11:55 PM AEDT.
apply_instructions: Apply now on the City of Greater Geelong PageUp board (job 500747) by 11:55pm AEDT 28 October 2026.
